summary: New AI21 Studio accounts receive a $10 free-trial credit — no credit card needed to start. CONFLICT as of 2026-09-28: the marketing pricing page (ai21.com/pricing) states "$10 credits for 7 days", while the docs page (docs.ai21.com/docs/usage-cost) still says "$10 credit good for three months". The listing follows the pricing page; verify at signup which window applies. Cloud-hosted AI21 models (Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure) are billed by those providers, not this credit.
claim_steps: Create an AI21 Studio account (no credit card required to start).
Use the $10 credit on Foundation Model APIs, SDK, and playground within the trial window.
Add billing information after the credit is used or expires to continue.
